title: First Meeting & The Endless Chai
story: Both of us showed up early on day one. Ended up sharing a cutting chai and talking for three hours about music, dreams, and how neither of us had any idea what we were doing.
insideJoke: "One more cutting chai and we can solve world peace."

title: The Unplanned 3 AM Road Trip
story: We were supposed to sleep early for exams, but someone said 'let's go watch the sunrise'. Next thing we knew, we were 80km away eating hot parathas at 4:30 AM in the chilly breeze.
insideJoke: "Google Maps doesn't know our destiny, bro!"

title: Hackathon All-Nighter Disaster & Triumph
story: Our laptop crashed at 4 AM with 2 hours until the demo. Survived on energy drinks, rebuilt the demo from memory, and somehow walked away with the 2nd place trophy.
insideJoke: "It's not a bug, it's a spontaneous surprise feature."

title: Graduation Day: We Actually Made It
story: Tossing our caps into the sky after all the chaotic semesters, late-night cram sessions, and endless laughs. A promise that no matter where life takes us, we stay brothers.
